notices.title: Khabele Bathhouse Rehabilitation at Barton Springs
notices.description: Joan Means Khabele Bathhouse at Barton Springs Pool has partially reopened. Renovated restroom and shower spaces are now available inside; please enter from the pool side of the building. The front parking lot is also reopened, except one small area that will remain fenced off for ongoing construction work. The building main entry at the rotunda and site work on the west side will remain closed to the public for construction. Read more about the partial reopening .

notices.description: The public boat ramp at Commons Ford Ranch Metropolitan Park will be closed and swimming at the park will be prohibited from Monday, October 12, 2026 through Monday, November 30, 2026. The City of Austin and the Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) are drawing down Lake Austin between Mansfield Dam and Tom Miller Dam during this period.
